validation.scope: One texel from each of up to 512 dispatched tiles, plus every thread pixel of the selected 8x8 tile; the actual GPU output packed word is compared per pixel with the CPU replay. Not a proof of every shader path.

notes: Texture bytes are decoded from the exact per-file SubresourceLayouts.StoredFormat; BC7/BC6H views are exporter-decoded and are not treated as compressed blocks. BC7 is recovered as 8-bit UNORM before sampling; BC6H remains float.
The LumenCardScene payload is read from the captured RDGUniformBufferParameters mapping for this pass; allocation-derived atlas size is not used when the payload is present.
GPU store format is R11G11B10 unsigned float; nearest and truncated predictions are both reported rather than assuming unverified hardware rounding.

Direct/indirect irradiance, emissive radiance and final radiance share the cache pre-exposure scale; albedo and interpolation/quantization multipliers are dimensionless. rho/pi is the Lambertian BRDF (sr^-1). This combine kernel does not apply scene exposure or tone mapping.
The compact float encoder is validated only for these finite captured values; it is not a general NaN/overflow/subnormal GPU format-conversion emulator.
Card candidate here is the selected dispatch tile, not a geometric ray hit. Surface-cache ray-hit interpolation is a separate operation.
